scope: Three vendored visual-profiler modules read whole, Git pin verified and Python3 syntax parsed. No GUI, target code, child thread or file output launched.

python3_syntax.message: Missing parentheses in call to 'print'. Did you mean print(...)?

findings: debug.py Python2 print statement and profilebrowser.py Python2 except syntax prevent Python3 import. functionprofiler transitively imports profilebrowser.
Timed runprofile requests KThread.kill without join, then prints done and returns true. Target thread may still run or report may not yet exist, especially blocked native work.
memorytrack/showprofile/callgraph decorators discard wrapped return values and lack finally handling for error cleanup/reporting. Instrumented behavior differs from plain call.

runprofilerandshow constructs executable Python expression by direct string concatenation with argv. Quotes/backslashes in ordinary arguments are not preserved as structured arguments; no expression executed in audit.
Calibration changes global profile.Profile.bias; no prior-state restoration. Fixed default profile.log can be overwritten by repeated/concurrent runs.
